title: Sugar and Spice Nuts
description: “I like to take something that’s generally ordinary and do it really well,” Bronson van Wyck says about these nuts. “With cinnamon, salt and sugar, they hit a lot of spots on the tongue.”
directions: Coat a rimmed baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.
In a small bowl, whisk the sugar with the salt, chile powder, cinnamon and cayenne pepper.
In a large bowl, beat the egg white until frothy.
Add the cashews, almonds and spiced sugar and toss.
Spread out the nuts on the prepared baking sheet and bake for about 45 minutes, stirring once, until browned.
Let the nuts cool on the baking sheet, stirring occasionally.
notes:
Make Ahead:
The spiced nuts can be stored in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
